notes.title: Update to version 1.037!
notes.notes:
Hello, Generals!

As some of you may know, I added the page for the new Home Wars, or "Home Wars: Battlefield", to Steam.
I want to suggest the new game because if you liked this HW, especially its FPS/TPS component, you would surely like Home Wars: Battlefield even more!

To those who ask me what kind of game it will be, I quickly answer "Helldivers 2 + Battlefield 4" (which are games that I love, by the way!)



CHANGES IN VERSION 1.037:

- I noticed I didn't keep a couple of fixes when I changed the game engine in the last update, so I added them.

- I smoothed out the colliders of some buildings (campaign map) a bit because I noticed that the armies were getting stuck in certain convex corners.

- In the start menu I added a little reminder for the new "Home Wars: Battlefield", so those who don't read the updates will know about the new title.



IMPORTANT:

If you love the concept of the "Home Wars" universe as much as I do, please help me spread the word about the game in development to other players.
Please support the development of "Home Wars: Battlefield" by adding it to your WISHLIST and spreading the word.
Please feel free to post the link to the new game's Steam page in any environment where interested players might be able to find it.

Unfortunately, I don't have the money to do a marketing campaign, so I'll post a few ads here and there.
For this reason, I ask you, as a developer-friend, to advise other players to add "Home Wars: Battlefield" to their wishlist.

We can't let bugs destroy this game forever!

If you have any ideas for cheaply advertising the game, let me know, and I'll try to implement them.


THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!

notes.title: Update to version 1.036!
notes.notes:
Hello, Generals!

In these months, you have pointed out to me that the game has problems starting.
Initially I was not too worried, because I know that this problem has always existed, but it affected very few players and I also never understood how to solve it, because I can never replicate it on my machines.
However, since I updated the game engine (Unity) in the hope of improving the experience for all users, I noticed that many more players were unable to start the game.

Even in this case, I could not replicate the problem on my computers, but something had to be done! I could not allow the hecatomb of insects to stop!

Consequently I opted for the most logical thing: I brought Home Wars back to the original game engine, trying to maintain all the improvements I had made in the last updates.
It really took me a long time, but it was the right thing to do for those who believed in me and in this project.


CHANGES IN VERSION 1.036:

- The game engine has been brought back to 2017! We are back to Unity 5.4!
I know it's always a paradox, but maybe it's the most stable way to play HW.
Let me know if you notice a performance degradation, thanks.

- I tried to keep all the improvements of the latest updates, but I definitely missed something, so if you notice it, let me know!

- I remember that some people complained about problems in the initial menu, I think they said they couldn't see/press some buttons.
I made some changes to the anchors of the various screens; tell me if it's better or worse now, especially for those with resolutions other than 16:9.


I want to point out that this great effort does not bring me any significant economic advantage, perhaps a few fewer refunds.
I did it because before being a developer, I am a gamer, or rather I would say a super gamer!
I know what it means to have your smile fade because of a game that does not start, which is why, for me, this type of problem has priority in being solved.

I take this opportunity to remind you to stay tuned with the news, because I am working assiduously on the new "Home Wars: Battlefield", even if I am encountering several problems in the development of the multiplayer component, which however I absolutely want to include.


The war against insects continues, my friends, and we are certainly not the ones to give up!

THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!

notes.title: Update to version 1.035!
notes.notes:
Hello, Generals!

In this update, I focused on a unit that I see as underestimated (at least from videos and posts) but which is very powerful: the Observer!

CHANGES IN VERSION 1.035:

- Cruise missile travel time decreased, but its blast radius was slightly reduced.

- The Smoke Grenade has a shorter recharge time, thus increasing its tactical contribution.

- The Laser-Guided Bomb still has its small explosion radius, but now it deals even more damage.

- Artillery Volley has slightly increased the radius within which projectiles can fall, so it has less accuracy.
However, his strikes are a little more powerful.
God bless artillery!

- Even the Support Crate has a shorter charging time because these guys need to be supported!

- The Support Crate should now have fewer problems descending, as previously it could "disappear" by touching certain surfaces above its desired landing point.


NEWS:

My first pixel art game "Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood" has just been released in Early Access.
I'd love it if you would take a look at it.
I hope you enjoy :)


Have a great Halloween, and see you in the next update, my friends!

notes.title: HOME WARS update to version 1.032!
notes.notes:
Hello, Generals!

As I have already told you in the past, I prefer not to get my hands on scripts written many years ago, in order not to create annoying unexpected bugs during your gaming experience.

However, I noticed that I could safely optimize the code, so I will gradually release patches aimed at improving game performance (obviously, you don't imagine 10,000 insects on screen at 120fps! :D ).

In this update, I focused on jumping bugs.
Consequently, with more of these bugs during battles, your computer should curse you less :D

The way landing is calculated has also been slightly tweaked, hoping that this won't hurt the movements of our hated bugs, for example, going under the floor.

REMEMBER that increasing the game speed worsens the movement quality of all units, especially the jumping insects, so use it only when necessary.


THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!

notes.title: HOME WARS update to version 1.030!
notes.notes:
Hello Generals!

This is a quick update, just to change a couple of things.

I added an initial panel that will appear up to 3 times, to push new players to review the product and to offer everyone my last 2 titles: Age of Undead and Gummy Dummy Battles.

Then I took a good look at the old scripts, and I understood where I could get my hands to optimize the product a bit and where it is better to avoid doing it.
If, by rereading the scripts, I have the opportunity to solve some simple bugs, that's welcome, but otherwise, I prefer to avoid modifying a code of which I have little memory now.

However, I should have speeded up the pathfinding process of walking insects; I focused on this because they are the ones most present in the battles.



DECISION FOR THE FUTURE OF HOME WARS:

After evaluating many aspects, I have decided, with EXTREME JOY, to put HOME WARS 2 in the development queue!

I speak of "development queue" because, before starting the real development of HW2, I have to complete 2-3 projects that I have now started, and they are the following:

1) A simple 2D game about American football, closer to a mobile game, but which I developed in my spare time because I would like it as a player.

2) Another 2D game, probably in pixel art, inspired by Vampire Survivors, but related to another theme with the hope of passing on an important message.

3) A 3D FPS, Ravenfield/TTS style (which, unfortunately, I already had in mind before Ravenfield came out), but with at least 2 big features that games of this type still don't have and many other minor ones!

The advantage of the latter game is that some problems that I have to solve for its development are the same that I will have for HW2; therefore, automatically, HW2 will also benefit from it.
Also, with all the good advice you've given me (and continue to do so!), HW2 will be literally a huge great title, which is why its development time won't be short at all, but on the other hand, to make well things take time! :)

In the meantime, thank you for taking part in the survey.
I will put more surveys in the future, so as to best plan HW2 to your tastes, my friends!

Have a nice day and have fun, everyone!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.028
notes.notes:
Hi Generals!

We've implemented the Night Battle feature in the Campaign!
We've read all your suggestions and we have chosen the Day-Night cycle.

In Settings/Game you can choose between 6 options:
- Always day
- 1 day - 1 night
- 2 days - 1 night
- 3 days - 1 night
- Always night
- Random

Now the default is "3 days - 1 night".

Like we wrote in the "Update 1.26", these are the changes the Night Battle brings:
- minor player visibility
- 50% less Visual Range of your soldiers
- enemy damage increased by 50%
- enemy venom attack increased by 50%

When you will win a Night Battle in Campaign, you will receive a +50% bonus EXP.


Remember: keep your eyes open and carry with a round in the chamber, because from now on there will be lots of close combat!

The only good bug is a damn dead bug!

Hello Generals!

Is there any news from the battlefront?

Here are the changes of this version:

- We've solved the "stove bug", now your troops will no longer fall from the stove.

We are a new, small team in the giant world of videogames. This is our first "true" videogame, so we have so much more to learn.
Thanks for your support and remember: The only good bug is always a dead bug!!!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.007
notes.notes:
Hello Generals!
As you can see, we are upgrading the game continuously, fixing bugs and improving the performance, but there are still so many things to do!

These are the new changes:

- As many of you have asked, we've made the difficulty of the campaign customizable, so now you can change it at any time!
These are the parameters that you can modify:
Fresh food abundance
Rotten food abundance
High protein abundance
Bugs per spawn.
The first 3 parameters set the amount of food that bugs can earn, while the fourth parameter adjusts the amount of bug units per spawn.
As it's an experimental phase, help us balance this new feature.
Old Campaign's saves may be incompatible with this update.

- We've increased the initial exp from 150 to 200.
Many players have complained they gain too little exp, but we want to push the player to make strategic choices and not just unlock all possible units from the first campaign.

This change should increase the effectiveness of the destruction caused by artillery and bombers.

- Some colliders of the Home 1 have been improved.

- Some small generic bugs have been fixed.

Generals, we have the troops and the technology required to wipe out these disgusting invaders from the face of the earth! 
Fight and war are in our nature!
DO YOUR PART!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.005
notes.notes:
Hello Generals!
This is the new update of the game, here are the changes:

- As many of you have asked, we have improved the navigation of all units (it wasn't a bug, but a bad optimization). Now your troops will respond to your orders better and faster.

- Many players reported us they couldn't hit some insects. Actually they got hit but didn't give you the feedback if the bullet hit their heads. However now this bug is solved.

- As many people have asked, now, the middle mouse button rotates the camera. 
In the Settings/Game you can find a bar that changes its sensitivity too.

- Minor bugs have been fixed.

- As some of you have asked, we have increased the range of "Ammunition Depot" in the battle.
Now it will supply faster the Supply Truck and the Helicopter Truck.

- The sound of the 81mm Cannons of the Spitlead has been changed.

- Some players have asked us to increase the lenght of the battle; for this reason we have tried to do so for 2 missions:
"Defend the allied Outpost"
"Destroy the enemy Outpost".

- We have increased the Health Points of:
Long Range Bomber
Strategic Bomber
Gunship
Spitlead.

- Some of you complained that the Ant Swarm hit them too early in the Campaign. For this reason we have decreased slightly the external Rotten Food and the Rotten Food gained from battles.

- Another "bug" that you have reported us is that soldiers can't shoot on very close enemies.
They could do it! You have to select the 4th behavior of the unit in order to set it to shoot to the closest enemy (IF they don't already have a target).
Now we'll set this behaviour as a default one for some infantry.
Vehicles and some heavy infantry can't attack very close enemies, but it's normal (a tank can't shoot a target that's one metre away from it), so their default behavior remains the 3rd one.

- Now some aircraft units will look for a target automatically, by default:
Strike Aircraft
Ground-Attack Aircraft
Interceptor Aircraft
Fighter Aircraft.
In the next update we'll implement the possibility to enable or disable this feature in Settings/Game.
However now you can disable it manually from the unity box, in the battle.

Generals, we haven't started this War, but we are going to end it!
Let's send them to Hell!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.004
notes.notes:
Hi Generals!

With this update we hope to solve the launch-crash problem that some of you had.
It's probably a resolution error and this update should solve it.

If you continue to have this problem, please try to:
- set a lower video quality than the current video quality, in the screen before the game launch.
- run the game as admin (right-click on the Home Wars icon on Desktop and then press "run as admin").
- add the game (the whole folder of the game and the process Home Wars.exe) to you antivirus' exclusions list.
- if it's not the first time you run the game, uninstall it and then reinstall it to make sure you don't have corrupted files.

Some computers make take longer to launch the game (even 2 minutes) due to the graphics card, especially on the first launch, so please just wait. If you get the Windows "Program is not responding..." screen, press "Wait for the program to respond".

We apologize for the inconvenience and we hope this update will solve the problem.
Let us know if it works.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

Hi Generals!
This is the second update of Home Wars, and here are the changes:

- The dynamite sound bug has been solved

- In Settings/Game you can now customize the plane's pilot sensitivity and invert the vertical axis. This setting can not be changed during the battle.

200 for the Allies
1000 for Bugs
As a result, the allies/bugs ratio in the Campaign has also changed, so update your Settings /Game/max units.

- The Sapper turned out to be overpowered, so from now on it won't be able to place its structures near enemies.

Generals do your part! Protect your homes!
Good luck!
